summary: C.H. Robinson filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026, disclosing an October 4 Agreement and Plan of Merger with RXO, Inc. Under the two-step structure, a Robinson subsidiary will merge into RXO, then the surviving entity will merge into a Robinson LLC, making RXO a wholly owned Robinson subsidiary. Both boards unanimously approved and RXO's board recommends stockholders adopt the merger. Consideration is an election of cash or stock per RXO share, though exact terms were not fully disclosed. The deal is intended as a tax-free reorganization and is expected to close in the first half of 2027. Watch for the exchange ratio, regulatory approvals, and any competing bids.
